notes: Tranche 0 storyboards are machine-checkable contracts for the human UX verifier before UI redesign.
Selectors are target contracts for later tranches; Tranche 0 validates schema and baseline evidence without requiring all target selectors to already exist.
Safety and contract markers must remain discoverable in the DOM even when moved into progressive disclosure drawers.

scenarios.title: Condition review storyboard
scenarios.goal: Review current generation, candidate quality, provenance, and gated export state without mistaking reference/demo output for live trading readiness.

steps.label: Understand current run state and mode

selectorAssertions.obligation: Task header states page purpose, mode, risk boundary, and primary action.
Reference/demo/live mode is visible in the task frame.

safetyAssertions: No Live Order text remains visible or discoverable.
Human Approval Gate text remains visible or discoverable.
No mutating request is issued on page load.

rubricObservations.observation: Mode and approval boundary are visible before any export action.

steps.expectedObservation: A researcher can tell whether the page is reference, demo, or live and what action is safe next.

steps.label: Inspect candidate and evidence chart

selectorAssertions.obligation: Primary candidate and evidence chart dominate the first working area.
Main chart has title, unit, active value, and provenance.
Focused/hovered chart value is available as text.

safetyAssertions: Export remains human-gated and separated from audit evidence.
Reference/demo data is labeled as fixture/static or fallback.

rubricObservations.observation: Main evidence chart is large enough and has textual active values.
Candidate inspection precedes any gated export decision.

steps.expectedObservation: The best candidate, its evidence, and the reason export is gated are all understandable without scanning many equal-weight cards.

scenarios.title: Backtest edit and validate storyboard
scenarios.goal: Select strategy/data, inspect or edit buy/sell conditions, validate, then review gated run and results with safety detail available but not blocking the task flow.

steps.label: Select strategy and data range

selectorAssertions.obligation: Backtest task frame is visible before contract detail.
Strategy/data/timeframe controls are grouped as the first workflow step.

safetyAssertions: The page does not POST to /bt/run on load.
The page does not POST to /bt/strategy/validate on load.
Reference/demo inert state is visible.

rubricObservations.observation: The user sees where to start without scrolling past the contract matrix.
Selection controls form a clear first step.

steps.expectedObservation: A researcher can immediately identify which strategy/data range will be tested.

steps.label: Inspect or edit buy and sell conditions

selectorAssertions.obligation: Buy/sell condition editor or code panes are large and visible near the top-level flow.
Condition editing shares the primary canvas with validation, not a low-priority card.

safetyAssertions: Saving remains manual-gated and not page-load triggered.
Strategy delete remains manual-gated and not page-load triggered.

rubricObservations.observation: Editor occupies enough area to compare favorably with V2 textarea layout.
Contract endpoint details are in an evidence drawer, not the primary editing area.

steps.expectedObservation: Buy and sell conditions are readable at V2-or-better size and are not hidden below safety tables.

steps.label: Validate, preview gated run, and analyze result

selectorAssertions.obligation: Validation result is visible as pass/fail/warning text.
Run/save actions are manual-gated with local reason text.
Result summary and chart are reachable in the same workflow.

safetyAssertions: Manual-gate reason is within 220px of the action.
No hidden production export marker is present.
Backtest contract markers remain discoverable in [data-ux-evidence-drawer=backtest].

rubricObservations.observation: Select, edit, validate, gated-run, analyze sequence completes.
Manual gate explains why actions are not automatic.

steps.expectedObservation: The user understands validation status and can see that execution is user-gated before results are analyzed.

scenarios.title: Chart Replay investigate signal storyboard
scenarios.goal: Choose source/date/symbol, choose strategy, preview replay bars/signals, manually start replay, and inspect synchronized chart and signal log.

steps.label: Choose source, date, symbol, and strategy

selectorAssertions.obligation: Replay purpose, mode, and risk boundary are visible first.
Source/date/symbol selection is the first workflow step.
Strategy selection is visible before playback controls.

safetyAssertions: The page does not open /sim/ws on load.
The page does not issue replay control frames on load.
Research-only and no-live-order boundaries remain discoverable.

rubricObservations.observation: V3 starts with the same intuitive source/date/symbol task as V2.
Manual /sim/ws gate is visible without making protocol detail the primary task.

steps.expectedObservation: A user can understand how to begin replay without reading the API/WS contract matrix first.

steps.label: Preview bars and manually start replay

selectorAssertions.obligation: Preview bars and signals are visible before playback.
Manual start gate is action-local and not hidden.
Playback/timeline controls remain sticky or first-fold visible.

safetyAssertions: Manual-start reason is within 220px of the start action.
Contract markers remain discoverable in [data-ux-evidence-drawer=chart_replay].

rubricObservations.observation: Preview and manual start can be completed without scrolling through endpoint tables.
Protocol detail is progressive-disclosure evidence, not the main canvas.

steps.expectedObservation: The user sees the replay timeline and can start only after an explicit human gate.

steps.label: Inspect main candle chart, selected bar, and signal log

selectorAssertions.obligation: Main candle chart is the primary visual canvas.
Selected bar details are available as text.
Signal log synchronizes with selected chart point.

safetyAssertions: Replay chart remains historical/research only.
No live order or broker/account affordance is present.

rubricObservations.observation: Main candle chart meets size threshold and exposes selected-bar text.
Selected chart value is readable without hover-only dependence.

steps.expectedObservation: The user can link a chart point to the relevant signal row and understand it is historical replay only.
